entities.summary: Evers Allen Burns is an American former professional basketball player who was selected by the Sacramento Kings in the second round of the 1993 NBA draft. A 6'8" forward from the University of Maryland, Burns played in only 22 games as a member of the Kings during the 1993–94 NBA season, averaging 2.4 points per game.
